'''Sean Patrick Hannity''' (born December 30, 1961) is an American television and radio host, political commentator, and author. He is best known for hosting ''Hannity (TV program)|Hannity'' on the Fox News Channel and ''The Sean Hannity Show,'' a nationally syndicated talk radio show. Over the years, Hannity has been a prominent and often polarizing figure in American media, known for his conservative viewpoints.

==Conspiracies and Controversies==
Hannity's career has been marked by several controversies and promotion of conspiracy theories. Among the most notable is his support for the ''Birther movement'', which falsely claimed that former President [[Barack Obama]] was not born in the United States. Hannity has also been a vocal proponent of the [[deep state]] conspiracy theory, suggesting that a covert network within the government operates against President [[Donald Trump]].

During the COVID-19 pandemic, Hannity faced criticism for initially dismissing the severity of the virus and promoting unverified treatments. His comments on the virus led to public backlash and debates over the role of media personalities in disseminating health information. Hannity's influence and statements were often linked to those who questioned the authenticity and seriousness of the pandemic.

==Connection to Alex Jones==
Hannity has occasionally intersected with other controversial figures, such as [[Alex Jones]]. While they haven't had a formal partnership, Hannity has occasionally echoed themes popularized by Jones, particularly on issues related to government distrust and conspiracy theories. Their shared audience and willingness to question mainstream narratives have created opportunities for their views to overlap, particularly concerning skepticism towards certain government actions and the media.

==Reception==
Despite the controversies, Hannity maintains a substantial following and has consistently ranked among the most influential media personalities. His shows, characterized by staunchly conservative views, continue to attract millions of viewers and listeners.
